title: feat(spec): ExecutionContext carries granted permission sets by (packageId, name)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb6DY4WMQRijjvpydLx3X8Jw)_

Fixes #31970

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no skill teaches the execution context's permission fields; `skills/` names `execution-context.zod.ts` only in three `references/_index.md` export lists, which `gen:skill-refs` writes (regenerated here)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：请求的执行上下文 `ExecutionContext` 多了一个可选字段 `permissionSetAddresses`，把用户被授予的每个权限集记成「哪个包 + 叫什么名字」（`{ packageId, name }`，环境自建或平台的权限集 `packageId` 为 `null`）。原来的 `permissions` 名字列表完全不动。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 让权限集按「包 + 名字」识别，两个包可以各有一个同名权限集；只有名字的列表分不清是哪一个。服务端（#31971）要先有这个字段，才能把解析出来的真实归属写进去。
- 风险与回滚：只新增、不收紧。字段没有默认值，本 PR 里谁都不填、谁都不读，所以每个请求的上下文与之前逐字节相同（core 的组装器显式决定它为「未填」，空值会被丢掉，测试证明人类、AI 代理、访客三种上下文都不带这个键）。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.zod.ts`（新 schema 与字段说明），`packages/core/src/security/assemble-execution-context.ts`（组装器加的两行），`packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.test.ts`（新字段的八条约束测试）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/kernel/execution-context.test.ts` 全部通过，其中缺 `packageId`、空 `packageId` 和空 `name` 三条被拒，缺字段时解析结果里没有这个键。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（契约扩宽需先由席位安排 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 复审）。

## What changes

**Spec** (`packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.zod.ts`):

- `PermissionSetAddressSchema` = `lazySchema(() => z.object({ packageId: z.string().min(1).nullable(), name: z.string().min(1) }))`, with `.describe()` on the object and both keys, plus the `PermissionSetAddress` (`z.input`) and `PermissionSetAddressParsed` (`z.infer`) types. `packageId: null` means a set no package holds: the environment's own or the platform's. The key is always present, and a package id is never `''` (contract review should-fix). The spelling follows the pending-drafts read in `api/protocol.zod.ts`, tightened to non-empty.
- `ExecutionContextSchema.permissionSetAddresses`: `z.array(PermissionSetAddressSchema).optional()`, declared directly after `permissions`, with **no default**. Its TSDoc and `.describe()` say it is filled only from a resolved `(package, name)` (ADR-0150 D3), never from a guessed holder; a name the resolution rule refuses never appears; `permissions` stays the display and compatibility field with the same order and contents; no reader consumes it yet; it is server-constructed only.
- `permissions: z.array(z.string()).default([])` is untouched.

**For the server half (#31971):** the derived names are `permissionSetAddresses` on `ExecutionContext` and `PermissionSetAddressSchema` / `PermissionSetAddress` / `PermissionSetAddressParsed` from `@objectstack/spec/kernel`.

**Core** (`packages/core/src/security/assemble-execution-context.ts`, claim amend 2): the assembler closes the envelope's field set by type, so a new `ExecutionContext` key does not compile until it is either assembled or declared non-entry. `permissionSetAddresses` joins `ENTRY_EXECUTION_CONTEXT_FIELDS` after `permissions` and is assembled as `undefined`, which `emit()` drops. Every envelope stays byte-identical, and #31971 replaces the `undefined` with the resolved value. The agent-ceiling branch is not touched.

**Description wording** (seat option A): the first wording said "absent means every consumer behaves as without the key", which `check:empty-state` read as a permissive empty state. The field is not an access gate, so the TSDoc and `.describe()` now state the contract directly: a context resolved without addresses parses without the key, and its absence changes no answer. No registry row was added.

**Regenerated artefacts** (all by their generators, none by hand): `api-surface/`, `export-origins/`, `declaration-map/`, `authorable-surface/` and `json-schema.manifest/` `kernel.json`; `content/docs/references/kernel/execution-context.mdx`, `data/data-engine.mdx` (which embeds the context) and `index.mdx` (1652 → 1653 schemas); the strictness-ledger count for `kernel/` (238 → 239). The three `skills/objectstack-{api,data,ui}/references/_index.md` lines are `gen:skill-refs` output: each export list gains `PermissionSetAddressSchema`. These are carved out of the governed fork by the `spec-skill-refs` register row in `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`. No hand-written `skills/**` file changes.

**Changeset** `.changeset/31970-permission-set-addresses.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/core` patch.

## Why

ADR-0150 identifies permission sets by `(package, name)`. A list of names cannot say which of two same-named sets a principal holds. This card adds the contract the server half fills; the server half resolves each grant through D3 and writes the address.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.test.ts`, new `describe` with eight cases: an absent key parses to `undefined` and is not in the parsed object (no default); a list with a `null` holder and a package holder round-trips in order; `[]` stays `[]`, distinct from absent; an empty `name` is refused at `permissionSetAddresses.0.name` (`too_small`); a missing `packageId` key is refused at `permissionSetAddresses.0.packageId` (`invalid_type`); an empty `packageId` is refused there too (`too_small`); `permissions` still defaults to `[]` and is not derived from the addresses; the element schema refuses the same inputs on its own.
- `packages/core/src/security/assemble-execution-context.test.ts`: one case. `permissionSetAddresses` is in the closed set, and no envelope carries the key on the human, agent or guest arm. The existing "every field is decided" test now counts the new key.

## Acceptance notes

- **Declaration lines measured, then amended by the seat.** The card said `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. `ExecutionContext` is on the authorable surface (`authorable-surface/kernel.json`), so the new key adds a row there. `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` refuses `none` when an authorable-surface baseline moves. Claim amend 1 set `yes (widening)` / `added` with a `minor` spec changeset.
- **Model tier.** `dispatch-gates --tier` derives a mandatory tier for the three generated `skills/**` index lines. The brief set the default tier, and the common rules forbid that tier for cards and reviewers. This is reported to the seat, which runs the contract review.
- **Dogfood battery: not run.** The title has no `!` and the Clause-② line has no `(narrowing)` arm.

## Verification

<details><summary>Readings (objectstack-ai/objectstack, head 6de705e0 = the merge of origin/main e24136c2, unless named)</summary>

- **Head 81ee58e4** (the review follow-up: `packageId` non-empty, `lazySchema`, one refusal case, regenerated `execution-context.mdx`): `check:generated` 14 of 14 up to date; spec `test` 829 files, 26250 passed, 1 todo; spec `typecheck` exit 0; derived gates 114 families, 113 exit 0, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED (exit 3, unbuilt workspace), `--ran` 0 unrun.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date", after `--fix` regenerated the six it proved stale. Re-run after the merge of main: still 14 of 14.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 829 files, 26249 passed, 1 todo. `typecheck`: exit 0. `test:repo`: 91 files, 1556 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test`: 143 files, 3256 passed. `typecheck`: exit 0. `test:repo`: 8 files, 100 passed.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols`: exit 0 (the new names collide with no ui declaration).
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 114 families at 9adb9dd9; the merge after it changed no file in this diff): 113 exit 0. One is NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 because the workspace is not fully built, and CI runs it. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 114 accounted, 0 unrun.
- Ablation (core): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `permissionSetAddresses: undefined,` with `permissionSetAddresses: [] as never,` (anchor 1 → 0 on disk). `assemble-execution-context.test.ts` went red: 188 failed, 30 passed, including the new case and the existing exact-envelope pins. It was restored to the HEAD blob `9b73fcc6`, with `git diff HEAD` empty.
